rule: GOAL: Fill four empty slots with colors to match the target sequence shown at the top. CONTROLS: Click a colored block to select it, then click an empty slot to place it. RULE: The order of colors in the top row must be replicated exactly in the slots from left to right. TRAP: Assuming the first available color is correct; checking the target order before placing prevents wasted moves.

GOAL: Reach the bottom-right corner. CONTROLS: Arrows make you slide until hitting a wall. RULE: You cannot stop mid-path; momentum carries you to the obstacle. TRAP: Assuming single-step movement wastes time; you must plan paths that stop exactly on the exit, not just pass it.

GOAL: Move the arrow to align with the yellow handle on the rail. CONTROLS: Click the blue squares on the right to shift the arrow up or down. RULE: The arrow moves one step per click until it hits a wall or the target. TRAP: Clicking the rail or arrow directly does nothing; you must use the side buttons.

GOAL: Guide the falling block to the right-side target. CONTROLS: Left and Right arrows shift the block horizontally; Space drops it. RULE: Blocks roll right upon landing on any surface, then fall off the edge. TRAP: Thinking blocks stop where they land wastes time; they always slide right to the edge.

GOAL: Navigate the square to the target center using limited diagonal moves. CONTROLS: Clicking a dot moves the square up to three grid steps toward that dot. RULE: The square travels exactly three dots per click, regardless of where you aim. TRAP: Believing you could jump farther by clicking distant points wasted time on failed moves.

GOAL: Align the moving green arrow with the static green marker on the track. CONTROLS: Click the right-side button to shift the arrow four steps forward per action. RULE: The arrow moves in fixed increments, requiring exact clicks to land on the two-column wide target. TRAP: Assuming the arrow moves one step per click wastes actions; it actually jumps four columns at once.

GOAL: Merge two distant pieces into one large block. CONTROLS: Click empty space near a piece to pull it closer. Click between two close pieces to merge them. RULE: Pieces only move if the click is within a strict distance limit. TRAP: Assuming you can merge pieces far apart. You must stepwise drag them together first.

GOAL: Place three boxes onto the charcoal frame band. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player and push or drag a held box; Space picks up or drops a box. RULE: You can only carry one box at a time, so return to the player to swap items. TRAP: Boxes on the band may look charcoal again; do not assume they are unplaced or need moving.

GOAL: Pair each left glyph with its matching right shape to clear the row. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor between slots; up and down cycle through available glyph options. RULE: Each left symbol dictates exactly one corresponding right shape, ignoring rotation differences. TRAP: Assuming exact rotational orientation matters; the game only checks shape identity, not angle.

GOAL: Align three plungers by moving fluid between bands. CONTROLS: Click side buttons to shift fluid up or down one band. RULE: Fluid always flows from the higher band to the adjacent lower band. TRAP: Believing you can push fluid uphill against gravity, wasting clicks on invalid moves.

GOAL: Decode the sequence to transform the bottom row into the target pattern. CONTROLS: Arrows shift glyphs within their columns. RULE: Each column cycles through a fixed order of shapes. TRAP: Assuming labels stay static; new shapes appearing during the scan can shift label indices, breaking your mapping.

GOAL: Align the block with the target zone by setting the correct path sequence. CONTROLS: Click toggle bars to change direction; click the central node to execute the move. RULE: The block follows the combined path of all active toggles in order. TRAP: Assuming the block stops at the first obstacle; it actually merges and continues if the path is continuous.

GOAL: Match the interactive grid to the target pattern shown on the left. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug; clicking paints grid cells. RULE: The level completes when the grid perfectly mirrors the target shape and color. TRAP: Thinking a green confirmation meant success; the pattern must match the target's specific purple hue, not just its geometry.

GOAL: Cross the horizontal corridor guarded by a stationary red enemy to reach the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one tile in the chosen direction. RULE: The red enemy lunges away from the player only when the player stands directly on its tile. TRAP: Believing the red tile is an instant-death hazard; stepping onto it actually forces the enemy to move aside.

GOAL: Merge pairs into yellow, then deliver to the center circle. CONTROLS: Clicking moves or merges pieces within a short radius. RULE: Merged yellow pieces are single units that move together. TRAP: Thinking pieces merge across the whole board; they only connect when very close.

GOAL: Clear the level in exactly two moves by aligning the small tip with the absorption zone. CONTROLS: Click the three white panel cells to shrink the wide tip into a narrow one, then press the UP arrow once to push it into the head. RULE: Each successful pattern match toggles the tip size; you need an odd number of matches to switch from wide to narrow. TRAP: Believing you must manually move the wide tip up; it gets stuck in the neck and must be shrunk via the panel first.

GOAL: Match colored blocks to the pipe's hidden sequence by swapping items between top and bottom rows. CONTROLS: Click two blocks to swap their positions; press space to validate the current arrangement against the target. RULE: The pipe dictates a specific reading order, processing top-left to bottom-right in pairs, requiring precise placement of each color. TRAP: Assuming the order follows visible layout rather than the internal definition caused repeated validation failures and wasted moves.

ESTABLISHED: The player starts at row 2 with time 5. Block b is attached at column 4. R sits at row 0 column 1. N sits at row 3 column 4. FAILED: Moving up twice fails to align all blocks in the player's row for capture. Vertical movement logic incorrectly assumes attached blocks do not shift with the player. GOAL IS NOT: Simply placing blocks in the same row as the player. The goal requires specific column slots 0, 1, and 2 to be occupied by R, N, and b respectively. CONTROLS: UP and DOWN move the player and attached blocks vertically. LEFT and RIGHT move the player horizontally. Moving into

GOAL: Place seven letters into nested slots to spell the hidden word. CONTROLS: Click a letter from the palette, then click a slot to place it. Press space to confirm. RULE: Fill slots using depth-first order: traverse the main row, diving into attached sub-boxes before continuing. TRAP: Do not fill the main row strictly left-to-right; ignoring the nested structure breaks the sequence.

GOAL: Decode the source string to fill seven answer slots with the correct glyph sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows navigate dials; confirm selections to lock in characters. RULE: Match the unique segmentation of the source string to the target code map. TRAP: Assuming ambiguous segmentation wastes time; verify the single valid path before rotating dials.

GOAL: Align six colors to a specific sequence by inserting a connector into a red slot. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, click slots to place, space to submit. RULE: The connector’s position determines the child box’s insertion point in the depth-first order. TRAP: Assuming colors fill slots sequentially ignores how the connector shifts subsequent positions.

GOAL: Clear the board by defeating all red enemies within a strict action limit. CONTROLS: Use arrow keys to move the player one step in any cardinal direction. RULE: Moving directly onto an enemy’s tile destroys it instantly and safely. TRAP: Fearing that proximity triggers an enemy attack causes you to waste turns on unnecessary detours.

GOAL: Decode a hidden message by applying a two-step color and shape transformation to a source string. CONTROLS: Arrow keys navigate the interface and rotate the answer slots to select the correct glyphs. RULE: Trace each source glyph through a graph of paired examples to find its final color and shape. TRAP: Assuming a direct one-step mapping exists; some glyphs require composing two separate transformations.

GOAL: Shrink the plunger to fit through the narrow collar. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the piece; clicking the panel matched the pattern. RULE: Matching the specific dot pattern triggered the size reduction mechanism. TRAP: Believing the plunger moves or shrinks immediately without first clearing the pattern lock.

GOAL: Extend the glowing tubes until they touch the black crosses to clear them. CONTROLS: Click the curved glyphs to lengthen or shorten the tubes; they act like directional arrows. RULE: Open curves pointing toward the target extend the tube; open curves pointing away retract it. TRAP: Assuming the glyphs are static decorations rather than interactive buttons that directly control tube length.

GOAL: Collect scattered dots using a cross-shaped sweeper. CONTROLS: Arrows move the center; space collects items. RULE: Dots are collected only when the cross arms pass directly over them. TRAP: Assuming every move triggers a collection; only the final resting position counts, so precise alignment matters more than sweeping paths.

GOAL: Change the highlighted outer grid to match the pattern shown in its center. CONTROLS: Click outer cells to toggle their color between blue and red. RULE: In the center key, gray blocks mean blue and white blocks mean red. TRAP: Assuming the center grid updates when you click the outer cells; it stays fixed as the reference.

GOAL: Turn specific grid cells orange to match the pattern shown in the two overlapping keys. CONTROLS: Click any blue cell to toggle its color toward the target state. RULE: The letter "W" in a key marks cells that must become orange, while "g" means leave blue. TRAP: Assuming the center color defines the rule; actually, the center is just a marker, and "W" dictates the change.

GOAL: Reduce the scattered pegs down to a single survivor. CONTROLS: Click a peg to reveal jump paths, then click a highlighted target to move. RULE: A peg only moves by jumping over an adjacent neighbor into an empty space, removing the neighbor. TRAP: Thinking you can jump into occupied spaces or move without a neighbor to leap over; only empty landing spots count.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to align the yellow block with the yellow cursor. CONTROLS: Click the left arrow to rotate the ring counter-clockwise; click the right arrow to rotate clockwise. RULE: Each click shifts the entire ring by one position in the indicated direction. TRAP: Clicking the grid corners or center is useless; only the side arrows affect the ring.

GOAL: Position the blob's center precisely on the target ring to complete the level. CONTROLS: Click empty spaces to move the tip; click the base to flip orientation. RULE: The middle bead’s position determines success, calculated as the midpoint between tip and base. TRAP: Assuming the tip must land on the ring, rather than using geometry to center the middle bead.

GOAL: Turn specific grid cells orange by interpreting four overlapping stamp patterns. CONTROLS: Click cells to toggle their color based on the active stamp rule. RULE: Stamps invert colors where their patterns overlap, creating a consistent target state. TRAP: Ignoring overlap consistency leads to wrong clicks; verify all stamps agree before acting.

GOAL: Guide the sliding block into the matching socket. CONTROLS: Arrows push the block; clicks select the active piece. RULE: The block slides until it hits a wall or overlaps a target marker. TRAP: Assuming the socket blocks movement; it is a landing zone, not a barrier.

GOAL: Turn green cells red and white cells orange using key centers. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell cycles its color through blue, red, and orange. RULE: A key determines the target color for all cells in its row and column. TRAP: Assuming every click consumes two bar units; here, each click only reduces the bar by one unit.

GOAL: Collect all hidden blue dots by moving the cursor and shapes to reveal and capture them. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected shape; Space cycles the selection between the cursor, diamond, and cross. RULE: Shapes reveal hidden dots when moved away from their positions, allowing you to see if they remain or vanish. TRAP: Assuming blue marks on the grid were always visible dots, rather than the arms of the cross blocking the view.

GOAL: Move two scattered blocks to cover both target cursors using the fewest moves. CONTROLS: Six buttons shift specific horizontal or vertical lines of blocks one step in a fixed direction. RULE: Each button cycles an entire row or column, moving all blocks within that line simultaneously. TRAP: Treating blocks as independent; a single button press affects every block in the selected line, not just the one you aim at.

ESTABLISHED: The display cycles through four distinct shapes every four activations. FAILED: Random guessing and ignoring the rotation pattern wasted significant moves. GOAL IS NOT: Solving a static spatial puzzle; the shape is dynamic. CONTROLS: Moving the player block over the cross triggers the next rotation in the cycle.

GOAL: Rotate the glyph to match the target pose, then enter the socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move a block; covering the cross rotates the glyph 90 degrees clockwise. RULE: The glyph cycles through four distinct poses, returning to start every four rotations. TRAP: Thinking any nearby block triggers rotation; only one specific lattice position covers the cross fully.

ESTABLISHED: The board features a black ring shape with two starting blocks. The tokens can navigate the grid without immediate obstruction. FAILED: Aligning both tokens in the same row, moving them to the top edge, placing them adjacent, and overlapping them at the same cell all resulted in no victory. GOAL IS NOT: Matching rows, reaching the top boundary, touching neighbors, or sharing a single tile. CONTROLS: Directional inputs move individual tokens one cell per step within the grid boundaries.

GOAL: Shift three blocks to match their target outlines. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected block; Space cycles selection. RULE: Only the highlighted block responds to arrow inputs. TRAP: Moving without checking the highlight wastes turns on the wrong object.

ESTABLISHED: SPACE rewinds the player and spawns a ghost replaying previous moves; pressing it again clears the ghost. FAILED: Pressing SPACE twice without moving the red box caused no change to the red box or the ghost state. GOAL IS NOT: Simply pressing SPACE to clear ghosts or rewind time without affecting the red box's position. CONTROLS: SPACE triggers rewind and ghost creation; directional keys move the player.

GOAL: Move two tokens to their target spots using only sixteen moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the left token normally, but mirror the right token’s horizontal direction. RULE: The right token’s left and right inputs are flipped, creating a mirror-symmetry puzzle. TRAP: Assuming both tokens use standard controls caused wasted moves when the right token went the wrong way.

GOAL: Rotate two overlapping loops to align all symbols in their target columns. CONTROLS: Click the left arc to shift its cycle clockwise; click the right arc to shift its cycle counter-clockwise. RULE: Shared cells move with the loop you click, forcing you to sequence moves so intersections land correctly for both sides. TRAP: Treating the loops as independent; ignoring that shared cells link the two cycles means one loop’s move disrupts the other’s progress.

GOAL: Match the hidden pattern to reveal the solution. CONTROLS: Click keys to set cell colors; click buttons to toggle states. RULE: A button’s color must match the pattern derived from overlapping keys. TRAP: Assuming buttons ignore pattern rules; their state counts as a cell requiring specific polarity.

GOAL: Rotate the plug and slide it to insert its prongs into the wall sockets. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the plug three cells per press; Space rotates it ninety degrees. RULE: Each arrow press moves the plug three cells, so align coordinates in multiples of three. TRAP: Assuming Space consumes the action budget wastes time; only arrow moves count against the limit.

GOAL: Guide the player to the exit while managing a dangerous obstacle. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; Space records moves, spawns a replaying ghost, and resets your position. RULE: The obstacle retreats only when the ghost occupies its starting square, creating a safe path. TRAP: Believing Space only adds a ghost; it also rewinds you, so you must re-enter the danger zone to let the ghost trigger the opening.

GOAL: Place colored tiles into red and blue boxes to match a target sequence, using connectors to bridge gaps between color groups. CONTROLS: Click palette tiles to select them, click empty slots to place them, and press space to submit the solution. RULE: Connectors must go in red slots exactly where color transitions occur, splitting the sequence into distinct contiguous blocks. TRAP: Assuming connectors can go anywhere; placing them incorrectly breaks the block structure and prevents a valid solution.

GOAL: Align the black shape with the yellow target by moving it down 33 and left 15 units. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the black shape; DOWN presses shift it down 3 units, LEFT presses shift it left 3 units. RULE: The shadow mirrors the black shape across the center divider, so moving left places the shadow on the right. TRAP: Assuming one press equals one unit of movement wastes time; each press actually moves the shape three units.

GOAL: Arrange colored tokens in three child boxes to match a nine-item target sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette items to place tokens; click spacebar to verify the solution. RULE: The order of connectors in the main box dictates which child box supplies which section of the target list. TRAP: Assuming all child boxes contribute to the same section; each connector strictly maps one child box to a specific three-item segment.

GOAL: Arrange colored tiles to match a target pattern. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, click grid slots to place. RULE: Nested sequences determine the final visible color order. TRAP: Placing tiles without checking the nesting depth causes mismatches.

GOAL: Move the yellow block to its matching bracket and the orange block to its own, placing both in the bottom-right area. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows shift the entire top or bottom row horizontally; up and down arrows shift vertical columns. RULE: Arrows affect the whole line simultaneously, so you must align blocks by moving the row they share rather than individual pieces. TRAP: Thinking arrows move single blocks wastes time; remember the entire line shifts together, requiring you to plan for collateral movement of other pieces.

GOAL: Move two yellow blocks to the marked spots on the top edge. CONTROLS: Red arrows rotate blocks clockwise along loops; green arrows reverse that rotation. RULE: The board contains two separate loops that share the top row, so one move shifts blocks across both paths. TRAP: Treating the loops as independent; moving one block often disrupts the other’s position along the shared segment.

GOAL: Align the black shape's mirror image with the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active object; Space switches control between the shape and the divider. RULE: The divider acts as a mirror; moving it changes the reflection's position and angle. TRAP: Trying to move the shape directly to the target; the reflection is fixed relative to the mirror.

GOAL: Move the knob to the yellow square to finish the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the knob; mouse clicks rotate the red arm and swap blue squares. RULE: The red arm must point vertically to block the upper path, forcing the correct route. TRAP: Believing the arm rotates freely; it actually toggles between two fixed positions.

GOAL: Bring the two tokens to the same square. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active token; one token moves normally, the other in reverse. RULE: Pressing a direction moves both tokens simultaneously, one forward and one backward. TRAP: Believing the mirrored controls swap positions; they stay attached to the specific tokens regardless of location.

GOAL: Turn the entire canvas purple. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the stamp; Space applies it; Click selects ink color. RULE: Rotation determines which half of the board the stamp covers. TRAP: Assuming rotation affects position; it only changes orientation, wasting time on unnecessary moves.

GOAL: Move the sliding bar upward to clear the path. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active piece; Space cycles control between the bar and shaped blocks. RULE: Holes in blocks show the color behind them, not control status; only the active piece responds to arrows. TRAP: Assuming block holes indicate control led to wasted moves; actually, Space simply cycles focus to the bar.

GOAL: Paint a diagonal split canvas using three colored stamps. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the stamp angle, clicks select ink colors, and Space applies the paint. RULE: Each stamp paints a specific triangular region defined by its current rotation angle. TRAP: Assuming the starting rotation was optimal; rotating to precise angles before painting saved crucial actions.

GOAL: Clear the path to the exit door by removing obstacles. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; mouse clicks activate pumps. RULE: Pumps shrink or destroy adjacent blocks to create space. TRAP: Assuming all actions cost equal energy; some clicks drain more than moves.

GOAL: Slide the yellow shape up and right to align its tabs with the green targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; clicks select a different piece. RULE: Overlapping pieces hide cells beneath them, reducing visible pixel counts. TRAP: Assuming tabs are separate from the body; they are part of the same moving object.

ESTABLISHED: The ship rises only when aligned with an open vertical shaft. Previous ascents matched the ship's five-column width to cleared corridors, confirming precise alignment is required. FAILED: Assuming shafts allow loose clearance or that horizontal movement triggers vertical ascent without prior structural opening. GOAL IS NOT: Simply moving the ship horizontally to a target location without clearing the vertical path above it first. CONTROLS: Left and Right shift the ship's horizontal position. Destruction of blocking boxes opens the necessary vertical shafts for ascent.

GOAL: Move the yellow marker to the target slot. CONTROLS: Click vertical arrows to rotate the arm. Click horizontal arrows to shift the ring. RULE: Vertical clicks rotate one step. Horizontal clicks shift one ring outward or inward. TRAP: Assuming arrow direction is obvious; test one click to confirm movement direction before calculating steps.

GOAL: Place two objects onto a yellow target that overlaps by nine cells. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active object; Space switches between objects. RULE: Objects can pass through each other, so order does not matter for final placement. TRAP: Assuming overlapping shapes require separate, non-touching positions wastes time on impossible moves.

GOAL: Guide the yellow tokens to their marked targets. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate the track segments horizontally or vertically. RULE: Tokens flow along the connected paths; rotation changes which routes are open. TRAP: Assuming tokens jump across gaps; they only move through continuous links.

GOAL: Guide the player to the exit while avoiding moving hazards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one square per press. RULE: Enemies move after every player action, not simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming enemies stop when you stop; they continue their patrol patterns regardless of your movement.

GOAL: Align all rotating glyphs to form the correct sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor between tiles; up and down rotate the selected glyph. RULE: Each tile cycles through a fixed set of shapes, so systematic scanning reveals the target. TRAP: Assuming the cursor position was incorrect caused wasted moves; always verify the active tile before rotating.

GOAL: Align the 3-wide ship with the vertical shaft to rise into the goal room. CONTROLS: Click boxes to remove walls; use arrow keys to move horizontally. RULE: The ship only rises when its collision body fits entirely within a shaft. TRAP: Assuming single-column alignment works; the ship requires a 3-column gap to pass through.

GOAL: Reach the center without colliding with moving enemies. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step per turn. RULE: Enemies occupy specific spots each turn; you must avoid their current and next positions. TRAP: Thinking you can pass through an enemy's current spot if it moves away; you cannot.

GOAL: Align the object with its reflections across two perpendicular mirror bars to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected component; Space cycles selection between the object, vertical bar, and horizontal bar. RULE: Reflections appear only when the object is positioned symmetrically relative to the active mirror axes. TRAP: Assuming reflections update instantly; they only render correctly after fully positioning the mirrors first.

GOAL: Place two shapes over matching colored dots to trigger completion. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active shape; Space switches between shapes. RULE: A shape only adopts a new color when its arm touches a matching zone. TRAP: Assuming direct paths work; shapes change color mid-transit if arms graze other zones, forcing costly detours to avoid wrong recolors.

GOAL: Clear the level by stepping on red tiles while avoiding moving orange enemies. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the player one step per press. RULE: Enemies followed fixed, repeating paths, allowing you to predict their safe positions. TRAP: Assuming enemies were static caused collisions; you had to time your moves to their cycles.

GOAL: Move four distinct shapes to their target spots to clear the board. CONTROLS: Arrows move the currently highlighted shape; Space switches control to the next shape in the cycle. RULE: Only the shape marked with white dots responds to movement; others ignore commands until selected. TRAP: Attempting to move a shape without first selecting it wastes actions, as it remains stationary.

GOAL: Move two colored blobs to safe zones without touching water. CONTROLS: Click a bead to attach it to the blob; click a target cell to move the blob and drop the attached bead. RULE: The blob only covers water if its center lands in a wet row, so route the center through dry gaps. TRAP: Assuming you must move every bead individually; instead, use one bead as a temporary anchor to shift the blob while others stay put.

GOAL: Connect the green piece to the assembly using its tabs to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the piece, Space rotates it, and actions track your progress. RULE: Matching tabs must align precisely with corresponding ports on other pieces to form a connection. TRAP: Rotating away from the assembly can leave merged cells that block future connections, complicating reassembly.

GOAL: Use the lever to press the floor icon, activating the red panel button to finish the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the knob; clicking the magenta button rotates the lever arm. RULE: Standing on the lever arm while rotating it carries you to new positions, allowing access to hidden switches. TRAP: Believing the knob must leave the arm to press the icon wastes time; riding the rotating arm is the key.

GOAL: Park a blue token at (8,11) while avoiding cyan tokens and other parked blues. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected token one step. Clicks select tokens. RULE: Mirrored tokens move in the opposite direction of the arrow key. TRAP: Assuming mirrored tokens move normally wastes moves; remember to invert controls for them.

GOAL: Reach the exit socket before your life bar fully drains. CONTROLS: Arrows move you; each step reduces the bar by two units. RULE: You must arrive with a specific remaining action count to succeed. TRAP: Believing you could survive long enough to grab distant power-ups after wasting time.

GOAL: Stamp four colors onto the canvas. CONTROLS: Click wells to select ink, arrows to rotate the tool, space to stamp. RULE: Match the tool's angle to the target block's orientation before stamping. TRAP: Assuming all colored pixels are targets, when the HUD border was mistaken for a block.

GOAL: Move pieces into the reflection zones. CONTROLS: Arrows move items; Space cycles selection. RULE: Pieces must align with the symmetry axes. TRAP: Assuming all shapes are symmetric; some need exact placement.

GOAL: Move the purple ring to its target without colliding with the green arm. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to slide the purple arm’s tip and position its blob. RULE: A blob cannot overlap beads or anchors belonging to the other arm. TRAP: Assuming a blob could pass through any empty space, ignoring collision with the other arm’s structure.

GOAL: Escape the pursuing chaser by reaching the exit in exactly four moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one square per press. RULE: The chaser moves two squares toward your current position after every player move. TRAP: Assuming the chaser keeps its facing direction; it actually re-orients to chase you every turn.

GOAL: Guide the blue to a meeting spot, then steer two cyans to collide there. CONTROLS: Click to select, arrows to move; cyans mirror each other’s inputs. RULE: The blue blocks cyan paths, acting as a static wall during their movement. TRAP: Ignoring the blue’s position as a blocker causes cyan moves to fail unexpectedly.

GOAL: Rotate the view to match hidden angles, then place colored markers to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the compass; clicks place markers; space confirms a placement. RULE: Rotation is relative to the current facing, not absolute screen direction, requiring careful tracking of cumulative turns. TRAP: Assuming arrow presses align directly with cardinal directions rather than rotating the entire frame of reference.

GOAL: Collect the ring, then use the launcher to drop the avatar into the socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move the avatar; touching the launcher propels it downward automatically. RULE: Manual travel to the socket is too slow; the launcher is the only viable shortcut. TRAP: Believing you can walk down the column is wrong; you run out of moves before arriving.

GOAL: Move the yellow piece to touch the blue square's center cells, turn it blue, and return to the start. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the piece one step up, down, left, or right. RULE: Only overlapping the square's center cells changed the piece's color. TRAP: Touching just a corner cell looked promising but failed to change the color.

GOAL: Vacate the target square so the orange could push the box into the goal. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the player to clear the path; Space waited for the orange to act. RULE: The orange only moves if the path is clear; standing in the way blocks progress. TRAP: Thinking you must push the box yourself. Moving to the goal square blocks the orange’s delivery route.

GOAL: Align four letter shapes to touch every tab. CONTROLS: Click to select a shape; arrows to slide it. RULE: Matching tabs turn the same color, locking the fit. TRAP: Assuming a shape fits immediately; you must rotate before sliding.

ESTABLISHED: The camera follows the ship vertically, keeping it near row 37 when possible. Screen coordinates shift as the world scrolls. FAILED: Clicking fixed screen coordinates to destroy obstacles above the ship without accounting for camera movement or intermediate rises. GOAL IS NOT: A static puzzle where screen positions remain constant regardless of the ship's vertical position or camera state. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the ship horizontally. Mouse clicks target specific screen coordinates to destroy obstacles.

ESTABLISHED: Chaser targets your previous position, not current. At (6,4) and (6,8), it is awake. FAILED: Treating the target as current position; simple dodging; assuming fixed tie-breaks. GOAL IS NOT: A simple chase where you run away; a puzzle requiring precise static positioning. CONTROLS: Move player; chaser moves after, targeting your start square, with complex tie-breaking on equal distances.

GOAL: Cycle the plug color to blue and insert it into the matching socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move the avatar; entering the mixer shifts the plug’s color; entering the socket completes the level. RULE: The mixer changes only color, not shape, and cycles through a fixed sequence of hues. TRAP: Assuming the mixer is single-use; it is reusable, but leaving and re-entering costs extra moves to cycle colors.

GOAL: Evade the pursuing chaser to reach the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one step in that direction. RULE: The chaser targets your previous position, allowing you to dodge by moving away from where you just stood. TRAP: Assuming the chaser tracks your current location; moving directly away from your last position is safer than fleeing your current spot.

ESTABLISHED: The yellow block is the target. The pink object rotates 180 degrees, carrying the knob across the gap. The blue socket is already filled. FAILED: Attempting to reach the yellow block without rotating the pink object. GOAL IS NOT: Placing the knob in the blue socket. CONTROLS: Right moves the knob; the magenta button rotates the pink object 180 degrees.

GOAL: Guide the large Y shape to the target circle without being eaten. CONTROLS: Click the map to move the Y toward that spot. RULE: The Y moves a fixed distance toward your click, ignoring obstacles. TRAP: Thinking the UFO can be avoided by staying high; it lunges far, so you must commit to a direct, fast route to the goal.

GOAL: Guide the moving tip and its center point to the target zone. CONTROLS: Click a spot to move the tip there; click a bead to swap positions. RULE: The center is the exact average of all connected beads in that color group. TRAP: Ignoring blocked paths; ensure both the tip and the center have clear routes to their destination.

GOAL: Rotate and slide the L-shaped piece to fill the gap in the letter D. CONTROLS: Click the piece to select it, press Space to rotate, and use arrow keys to slide it into position. RULE: The shape must rotate exactly three times to match the slot’s orientation before sliding into place. TRAP: Clicking empty space near the target fails to select the piece; you must click directly on the colored body.

GOAL: Guide the plunger to the right shaft socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plunger; keypad inputs pump it to sockets. RULE: Absorbing green charge refills time and expands the plunger to fit large sockets. TRAP: Believing the time bar only decreases; collecting charge actually extends your budget.
